policy: A strict phylogenetic bridge is accepted only when the exact source species/protein is curated, a peer-reviewed phylogeny explicitly includes that accession together with human target and relevant human paralogs, an independent modern exact-species transcript or protein observation exists, and Open Targets validates the nominated human Ensembl target. Sequence similarity alone is insufficient.

Cynops pyrrhogaster.phylogeny_method: Neighbor-joining phylogeny of 21 Hedgehog-family proteins after Clustal X alignment; 500 bootstrap replicates; Poisson-corrected distances.
Cynops pyrrhogaster.rationale: Peer-reviewed Hedgehog-family phylogeny explicitly includes Cynops pyrrhogaster SHH Q90385 alongside human SHH, IHH and DHH, providing paralog discrimination. A 2024 Cynops regeneration study independently cloned the species' Shh transcript (PQ306330) from limb blastema.
